# Oral History in the Digital Age

> A comprehensive resource for digital oral history best practices, preservation standards, and technical guidance supported by Michigan State University and the Institute of Museum and Library Services.

OHDA provides educators, archivists, and oral historians with evidence-based practices for recording, preserving, and providing access to oral history collections in the digital age. The project is led by Doug Boyd and Dean Rehberger at Michigan State University's MATRIX center and features guidance from leading oral history institutions including the University of Kentucky Libraries and the Library of Congress.

## Key Topics

- Oral History
- Digital Preservation
- Metadata Standards
- Audio Recording
- Video Standards
- Archival Best Practices
- Copyright & Intellectual Property
- Creative Commons Licensing
- Equipment Guide
- Project Planning
- OHMS (Oral History Metadata Synchronizer)
- Analog-to-Digital Conversion
- Accessibility & Discovery
- Legal & Ethical Issues
- IMLS Funding

## Getting Started & Core Resources

- [Oral History in the Digital Age](https://ohda.matrix.msu.edu): Homepage for OHDA project covering oral history digital technologies and best practices
- [Getting Started](https://ohda.matrix.msu.edu/gettingstarted): Comprehensive getting started guide for oral history projects and digital preservation
- [Best Practices](https://ohda.matrix.msu.edu/best-practices): Best practices guide covering equipment, preservation, and project management
- [About](https://ohda.matrix.msu.edu/about): Project overview covering digital preservation, archival practices, and IMLS funding

## Technical Reference & Glossaries

- [Glossary](https://ohda.matrix.msu.edu/gettingstarted/glossary): Glossary of oral history, audio, and video technical terms and standards
- [Audio Glossary](https://ohda.matrix.msu.edu/gettingstarted/glossary/audioglossary): Audio recording standards and terminology for archival-quality digitization
- [Video Glossary](https://ohda.matrix.msu.edu/gettingstarted/glossary/videoglossary): Video standards, compression, and technical reference for digital video
- [Archives Glossary](https://ohda.matrix.msu.edu/gettingstarted/glossary/archiveglossary): Archival terminology including metadata, preservation, and data integrity concepts

## Video Playlists & Learning Modules

- [Playlists](https://ohda.matrix.msu.edu/gettingstarted/playlists): Curated video playlists on equipment, legal issues, and project planning
- [Equipment](https://ohda.matrix.msu.edu/gettingstarted/playlists/equipment): Audio and video recording equipment guide for oral history projects
- [Digital Preservation](https://ohda.matrix.msu.edu/gettingstarted/playlists/digital-preservation): Digital preservation strategies, case studies, and analog-to-digital conversion
- [Cataloging and Metadata](https://ohda.matrix.msu.edu/gettingstarted/playlists/cataloging-and-metadata): Best practices for cataloging, metadata standards, and collection management
- [Legal Issues](https://ohda.matrix.msu.edu/gettingstarted/playlists/legal-issues): Legal and ethical issues including copyright, IP, and Creative Commons
- [Access](https://ohda.matrix.msu.edu/gettingstarted/playlists/access): Guide to accessibility and discovery using OHMS and metadata standards
